data: What are the primary components analyzed in the figure?

The primary components analyzed in the figure are the principal components of the distribution of values for each principal component on 'c' and 'u'. The vertical axis represents a standard deviation. The figure also shows the results of PCA and re-PCA of 'u' vectors in the learned LSTM, with characteristic dimensions of each POS being distinguishable.
